scope: Reconcile 62 existing selected-source synthesis rows into shared drug-condition-outcome summaries. No new acquisition, original-paper extraction, or source-status verification.
authority: Owner October 12 2026 request for Examine-style outcome-level A–F benefit assessments, separate effect and evidence counts, one condition group and right research drawer. Latest owner scope supersedes prior confidence-column presentation; original confidence assessments are retained.
sourceAccess: Canonical accepted extraction and prior editorial records only; not fresh source inspection.
tiers: Eligible original clinical reports support clinical findings; context and computational evidence never increase RCT counts.
identity: Keep every original synthesis/source identity. New summary IDs map original rows. Normalize demonstrable duplicate reports by DOI/PMID and documented common trial; dedupe participants across families and repeated outcomes.
scopeRules: Do not pool prevention and established-disease treatment.
Keep distinct endpoints/timepoints in separate summary rows, grouped under one condition heading.
Combine compatible outcome rows only with explicit rationale; do not calculate undocumented pooled effects.
Record held/correction and nonhuman-only findings without a fabricated benefit letter.
Count only actual randomized comparisons relevant to the stated drug outcome; retain randomized dose/regimen studies with explicit attribution limits.
Missing, ambiguous and conflicting participant denominators remain null with reason.
ownership: outcome_data worker writes new data/adapter/contracts/check only; parent integrator owns component and project contract integration.
acceptance: All 62 input syntheses mapped once; original records untouched.
Explicit rationale, source locators, authored date, source fingerprints and honest review status.
Unique study families and participant totals agree across row/group projections.
Reject stale inputs, missing rows, mismatched IDs, manufactured null-to-F grades, duplicate trial totals and zero for unknown participants.
Independent integrator acceptance after data and browser checks.
rollback: Remove new summary adapter/projections; immutable original synthesis and assessment inputs remain untouched.
release: AI-assisted selected-source editorial draft; no human scientific approval, exhaustive search, Q01–Q15 completion or deployment implied.
